description:
About the Scholarship

MSc European Forestry is an Erasmus Mundus joint master in forest sciences coordinated from the University of Eastern Finland in Joensuu. The next call for student applications runs from 2 December 2026 to 13 January 2027 for the cohort starting in August 2027, and applications go through the Finnish Studyinfo service.

OpportunityMSc European Forestry (Erasmus Mundus)
HostMSc European Forestry Consortium (UEF)
LocationJoensuu (multi-country mobility), Finland
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for the best-ranked
Application Deadline13 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

MSc European Forestry is an Erasmus Mundus joint master in forest sciences coordinated from the University of Eastern Finland in Joensuu. The next call for student applications runs from 2 December 2026 to 13 January 2027 for the cohort starting in August 2027, and applications go through the Finnish Studyinfo service.

Programme Highlights

  • Erasmus+ Erasmus Mundus branding in forest sciences with a strong European mobility path
  • Application window of roughly six weeks: 2 December 2026 – 13 January 2027
  • Start in August 2027 with field courses across European partner universities
  • Careers in forest management, EU forest policy, certification and climate research

Who Should Apply

Forestry, environmental and biological science graduates fit best; the Studyinfo application carries the standard document set including English proficiency evidence.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for the best-ranked applicants: tuition coverage plus a monthly allowance for the two-year programme.

Deadline and How to Apply

Use the Studyinfo link on the programme site once the window opens on 2 December 2026 and submit before 13 January 2027. Key deadline information: 13 January 2027; application window 2 December 2026 – 13 January 2027 (via Studyinfo).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About MSc European Forestry Consortium (UEF)

The MSc European Forestry consortium is coordinated by the University of Eastern Finland and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in European Forestry with partner universities across Central and Western Europe.

Official website: https://sites.uef.fi/europeanforestry

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 13 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

  • University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
